expectations.text: The check command exits 0 (features.json has the three spec behaviours, all passes:false; todo.js not written)
Each feature names an exact command that checks it (e.g. node todo.js add "x" prints added: x)
expectations.evidence: All 6 features in features.json have a concrete bash `check`. For example, add-prints runs `[ "$(node todo.js add 'buy milk')" = 'added: buy milk' ]` and done-prints runs `[ "$(node todo.js done 1)" = 'done: a' ]`.

expectations.text: The proposed /goal condition is one measurable end state with the exact check, plus constraints or a turn bound, not a vague wish like 'everything works'
expectations.evidence: The /goal names one end state: run the exact node runner command and see 'PASS for all 6 features and exit 0'. It adds two constraints: 'git diff --quiet HEAD -- features.json SPEC.md succeeds' and 'todos.json in the repo must still contain []'. There is no turn bound, but the expectation accepts co
